objective: Use the normalized local AC Hunter snapshot to prioritize review and develop competing hypotheses without treating behavioral scores or correlations as proof of malware.
preconditions: a normalized AC Hunter snapshot already exists in the local authoritative store
snapshot freshness completeness and source-status metadata are present
the behavioral context can be joined to an independently attributable host or flow
required_evidence: snapshot schema version freshness dataset and source completeness
module findings verdict counts and correlated hosts with normalized identities
independent first-party telemetry for any conclusion beyond review priority
positive_evidence: fresh complete cross-module findings raise the review priority for an independently attributable host
specific normalized behavior and correlation facts support a bounded hypothesis that can be tested in primary telemetry
negative_evidence: a fresh complete snapshot contains an explicit benign explanation that contradicts the scoped behavioral hypothesis
complete module and correlation coverage weighs against the exact hypothesis when independently joined to the same host and time
escalation_pivots: validate the host and time in Security Onion primary telemetry
compare specific module findings with an approved benign explanation and asset role
stop at review prioritization when independent corroboration is unavailable

query_templates.purpose: Read the stable locally normalized snapshot projection only; do not invoke collection transport or upstream APIs.

alternative_hypotheses: high scores reflect a legitimate rare service or approved application
correlated modules reuse the same underlying observation and are not independent
shared infrastructure or NAT causes identity ambiguity
stale partial or failed source collection distorts behavioral context
stop_conditions: the review priority and smallest primary-telemetry pivot are documented
the task asks AC Hunter to provide malware proof or a compromise verdict
the task would trigger collection or contact the Relay or upstream AC Hunter service
freshness completeness identity or independent corroboration is insufficient
confidence_limiters: scores and correlations prioritize review but never establish malicious intent
correlated findings may not be independent
this reports.read boundary cannot trigger collection Relay transport or upstream access
known_false_positive_patterns: legitimate conferencing telemetry VPN and cloud applications
